title: Component
description: UI component instance on a Page (BE-02, SCRUM-20). Full UI type catalog is deferred (DEF-05); type is an open string, not a closed enum (T-12 gap).

type.description: Component type string (SCRUM-20). T-12 examples include text-field, select, table, button, date-field. Not a closed enum in Phase 1 (DEF-05).

position.description: Grid position. Keys taken from the T-12 outline example { row, col }. Origin is (0, 0); negatives are invalid.

size.description: Grid size. Keys taken from the T-12 outline example { width, height }. Span must be at least 1 so the component occupies space.

visibility.description: Whether the component is visible (SCRUM-20, T-12).

disabled.description: Whether the component is disabled (SCRUM-20, T-12).

fieldKey.description: Optional mapping to a generated entity/DTO field (T-12). WorkOrder sanity check uses orderNumber, status, dueDate, assignedTo.
